title: Reforming Artificial Intelligence: A Call for Cognitive Containment
content: Advances in neurocognitive AI heighten autonomy and misalignment risk. We propose Reforming AI through cognitive containment: a proactive architecture that bounds capability before scaling. The framework comprises three layers: the AI system with cognitive modules; a reformative layer embedding ethical anchors, and cognitive firewalls; and a human–societal layer of policy, law, and oversight. Design primitives include bi-directional cognitive locks and containment protocols that isolate higher-order reasoning from self-replication. This agenda reframes intelligence as bounded, auditable cognition and shifts safety from reactive mitigation to safety-by-design governance aligned with human values.
